title: Webb captures detailed beauty of Ring Nebula (NIRCam image)

evidence.locator: 4097 x 4156 px over 2.14 × 2.17 arcmin; NIRCam 1.62, 2.12, 3.0 and 3.35 µm; released 21 August 2023. The file's embedded sky tags for scale and direction, 0.0314 arcsec per pixel and north 140.2° right of vertical, and the star for place: the central star in the picture, pixel 2123, 1991.4, is set at the place the Ring Nebula's page stands at, so the frame's centre is 283.3950727°, 33.0293034°. The tags alone put the star 0.13 arcsec from where the picture shows it.
